method: Read-only CPU Python metadata, importlib.util.find_spec, pyvenv.cfg and source-file inspection; no model or GPU package execution

lane_freeze.comparison: Parse non-editable, non-URL requirement lines and compare importlib.metadata.version against each packaging.Requirement specifier; direct VCS provenance checked separately below

source_resolution.scope: Observed in the audit subprocess with the explicit PYTHONPATH above; this does not inspect or attest another running process's environment

decision.reason: The installed lane matches its dedicated freeze. Repository root has no uv.lock; verl/uv.lock specifies a distinct vLLM 0.24.0 / Transformers 5.9.0 stack. Syncing that project would change the selected stack, not merely activate it.
decision.selected_mimo_configuration: Explicit SDPA, use_remove_padding=false and naive checkpoint backend match the selected colocate_async smoke path without requiring missing FA2/CuPy.

read_only_boundaries.limits: Metadata/version and module-resolution evidence only. This does not validate binary package integrity, CUDA kernels, CUDA IPC, GPU capacity, rollout, training updates or checkpoint reload.
